completedTasks.title: Clear the system proxy when ai-proxy dies
completedTasks.summary: A guard sidecar (same binary, --guard-system-proxy) watches a stdin pipe from the proxy; end-of-file without a 'restored' line means the proxy died, so it clears the system proxy under an exclusive marker lock (~/.ai-proxy/system-proxy.lock). A stale unheld marker at startup clears before Set, covering reboot or a killed guard. Clearing goes through a throwaway ProxyServer so Titanium never snapshots the dead proxy as original. Research showed Titanium cannot snapshot side-effect free on Windows/Linux, so full restore is deferred.
followUps: #24: restore the original proxy (own per-OS snapshot) instead of clearing.
Manual kill -9 check of the real clear path on macOS; Windows and Linux untested.

completedTasks.title: v1 phase 2: the content compression pipeline
completedTasks.summary: The proxy now shrinks the tool output in a request before the provider sees it, and keeps what it dropped. A region finder reads the body twice, once through the parsed document to learn which string values carry a tool output and once through the raw bytes to learn where they are, so a region is found by position and a message the client wrote that repeats the tool's words is left alone. A decomposer splits a region by structure, a router lets each handler claim the kinds it handles, and nine reducers keep a subset of the text they were given. The must-keep overlay re-attaches what a reduction dropped, with a ceiling of five percent, and five new rules cover the decisions class the measured pattern missed. A SQLite store keeps the original, the compressed text, the ratio and the path that was taken, through a queue table that is committed before the request is forwarded, and the original is served back from /content/{id}. The stage is off until PROXY_COMPRESSION=on. 188 tests.
decisions: The stage implements the existing ICompressionPipeline seam, so the host registers exactly one pipeline and the pass-through stays the one used when the stage is off.
A region is found by its position in the body, not by its content, because a value-set match would rewrite a string the client wrote that happened to repeat the tool's words.
The store is its own adapter project, and SQLite is the queue that carries a record from the request path to the writer. ADR 0002, draft.
The must-keep overlay may cost at most five percent of the reduction, and the decisions-class tokens are the ones that survive that ceiling.

The measured script's deduplication kept every copy of a repeated line, because it zeroed the counter of a line it had already kept. The port keeps the first copy, which is what the script's docstring said it did, and the record says so.
The stage is off by default, because it changes what the provider is sent.

The owner ruled that the rule-based prose reducer ships and the measurements are corrected rather than the feature dropped: the measured deduplication was a no-op, so the rule path's size figures came from the signal filter and the anchors alone.
The owner ruled that the store stays in its own project, src/AiProxy.Storage, and ADR 0002 stands. A panel lane had preferred the web host.
The owner ruled that the four corrections are folded into the two research records now in main, as a follow-up pull request.
The owner ruled that the next task measures whether an agent answers as well from the reduced context, and the model path waits for that answer.

completedTasks.title: v1 phase 1: the structure and the proxy skeleton
completedTasks.summary: The proxy detects the provider of an inbound request, routes it through an ICompressionPipeline (pass-through for now) to that provider's upstream, and carries everything else through unchanged. The static detector became a composite of the path, body and header signals behind IDialectDetector; the router applies the credential rule and refuses with routing_unknown or routing_credential_ambiguous; the host is a minimal API with a middleware pipeline, a hop-by-hop-stripping forwarder that relays a streamed response chunk by chunk, and a DI composition where every collaborator is a singleton. 84 tests.
decisions: The core project holds the interfaces and the rules and depends on nothing; the host project holds the middleware, the forwarder and the composition. ADR 0001, draft.
The pass-through rule is checked after the path signal and before the body signal, so a request to an operator's prefix cannot be captured by a body shape. This corrects the v1 plan's wording.
A body larger than 8 MiB is refused rather than forwarded unread.
